title: Garlic-Butter {p} with {v}
steps: Pat the {p} dry and season generously with salt and the {spice}.

Sear in a very hot oiled cast-iron pan, about 4 minutes on the first side. Flip, add the {sauce}, and baste with the melted butter for 3 to 4 minutes. Check the thickest part with a thermometer. The USDA safe minimum for steak is 145°F / 63°C. A lower doneness is your choice and carries more risk.
Rest the {p} 5 minutes, then slice thinly across the grain.
Serve with the {v} and {s}, with the pan juices spooned over.
tip: Slice thin and keep the portion palm-size, with the vegetable filling half the plate.
